title: Support of slices (Simon 4.8)
statement: For all P, m, every open U ⊆ ℝ^P, every T ∈ D_{m+1}(U), every f : ℝ^P → ℝ which is L-Lipschitz on U, every t ∈ ℝ and every S ∈ D_m(U) with IsSlice T f t S: spt S ⊆ spt T ∩ {x : f(x) = t} (supports in the sense of GeometricCurrentOn.support, relative to U).
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ T : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1), ∀ (f : Eucl P → ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0), LipschitzOnWith L f U → ∀ (t : ℝ) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U m), IsSlice T f t S → S.support ⊆ T.support ∩ {x | f x = t}
